title: Orientation Compass: Microflow Canvas for First-Run Checklist & Empty States
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and deliver a compact microflow canvas that combines the first-run checklist, contextual empty states, and targeted tips for the Redwood Console. This ticket covers finalizing visual assets (static + animated), microcopy variations for 3 personas (platform engineer, product engineer, data scientist), and a screenshot staging set that product will use in release notes. Deliverables: figma master file, export-ready PNG/SVG sprite set, three small motion specs (fade/slide/pulse), and copy doc with localization-ready strings.
tasks: Audit existing onboarding assets and list reusable components (deadline 2026-02-26)
Sketch three microflow variants: guided-lane, compact-tile, and progressive-strip
Produce empty-state hero illustration set (3 sizes + grayscale variant)
Write microcopy variants for persona A/B tests and localization keys
Prototype interactions in Figma and record 3 short videos for engineering handoff
Export sprite sheets and provide naming convention for engineering
Accessibility pass: contrast, focus order, and motion-reduction alternatives
Prepare release screenshots and captions for product release notes
updates: 2026-02-22: Initial audit complete; identified 7 reusable SVGs and 4 patterns to retire.
2026-02-27: Low-fidelity sketches reviewed with PM and ENG; agreed to pursue 'compact-tile' primary flow.
2026-03-05: Microcopy A/B variants written; PM requested a version that surfaces Dedicated benefits for enterprise users.
2026-03-09: Accessibility review scheduled with Accessibility Guild for 2026-03-12.
2026-03-14: Motion specs updated to include 'reduced motion' mode and pause on hover; engineering thumbs-up pending resource mapping.
review_feedback: PM (Ibrahim Patel): Prefer clearer CTA labeling when recommending Dedicated vs Hosted paths.
Eng Lead (Sofia Martinez): Suggested reducing initial animation frames to avoid jank at low bandwidth devices.
Design Lead (Noah Rivers): Approve illustration direction but asked for tighter spacing and tokenized color variables.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file has organized layers and component variants for all three flows
Exported assets (SVG/PNG) exist in repository with naming scheme and size variants
Microcopy signed off by PM and localization-ready (placeholder keys included)
Prototype shows reduced-motion alternative and passes basic keyboard navigation test
Engineering has a handoff ticket with assets attached and timeline agreed for integration
design_notes: Prefer 3-color palette derived from console theme to keep visual parity with existing empty states
Use single-line illustrations for compact mode; reserve richer illustrations for progressive-strip when space allows
CTA hierarchy: Primary action (Get Started) > Secondary (View Docs) > Tertiary (Skip Tour)
Animation budget: 250ms entrance, 150ms secondary; avoid long looping animations on first-run screens
accessibility_checks: All interactive elements reachable via keyboard with visible focus outline
Motion-reduction variant available for users with prefers-reduced-motion
Illustration alt text and aria-label suggestions included in copy doc
qa_checklist: Verify exported assets render correctly at 1x, 2x, and 3x on staging
Confirm microcopy matches localization keys and no hard-coded strings in screenshots
Test onboarding flow on Chrome, Firefox, Safari and mobile viewport widths
Ensure console SSO users see enterprise-specific tip copy when flagged by backend
